feeds.title: Wondermômes
feeds.description: Valérie, mother from the North. 3 WonderMomes born in 2005, 2008 and 2011, avid readers a bit geeky and Harry Potter fans since forever. Here I talk a little about everything that touches me / us: family life, outings and trips, books, genealogy, bullet journal, tests, cooking recipes, books, and more.

feeds.title: Marjolaine Solaro
feeds.description: I am Marjolaine Solaro , I blog under the pseudonym of Marjoliemaman since April 2008. I work from my home which allows me to better manage my professional life, my life as a mother, and my life as a woman. At best but always in speed!

feeds.title: C'est Quoi Ce Bruit ?
feeds.description: Family, lifestyle, and travel blog of a mother from the Var. The feminine touch of an addict to the net, to wine, and to gluttony!

feeds.title: Deux Fois Maman
feeds.description: Welcome to our house ! We are two mothers filled with the arrival of two children each in our lives.Amanda, 30, mother of a baby boy born in September 2012 and a baby girl born in July 2014.Sophie 29 years old, mother of a little girl born in February 2010 and a little boy in April 2013. FIND HERE THE TOP NEWS from parents, advice on toys, beauty, household, pregnancy tips, contests.

feeds.title: Ciloubidouille
feeds.description: I am Cécile, creative slasher, self-entrepreneur, mother of 4 children, content creator, digital visibility coach passionate about authentic marketing, inventor of fun training courses to boost your creativity, budding podcaster, seller of manual boxes, jewelry and even clitoris.

feeds.title: Merci pour le chocolat !
feeds.description: My name is Céline Dupont. I am the mother of 3 grown-up children aged 21, 18 and 16, and I am married to the wonderful Mr. Cheri. I created this blog in May 2006 because I wanted to share the jokes and childishness of my children then small, as well as my experiences as a young mother. Over time, my blog has grown to cover many themes of travel, lifestyle, family and everyday life.

feeds.title: Première fois Maman
feeds.description: I am Bibi. I share in this blog my experience for mothers , future mothers and those curious about motherhood . Here you will find tips, tricks ( pregnancy, baby, motherhood ) and my parenting adventures.

feeds.title: Phénomène de Maud
feeds.description: My name is Maud, I live in Lyon. My little family is made up of Lisa, Giacomo and Paolo. You could say I'm a cat granny. Tigger, Luckie and Dumbo are the 3 felines of the house. I am passionate about photography, cooking, traveling, reading and writing.

feeds.title: Maman Mi
feeds.description: The daily life of a mother of three children in Auvergne, quite simply. Blog posts cover articles on motherhood, parenting, recipes, travel, and more.

feeds.title: Maman Pavlova
feeds.description: I am Mama Pavlova. The mother of a little Indian girl, born in June 2016 after a long fight with Pma.Papa Bear and I are raising our baby girl in kindness and mothering (and fathering). We are convinced by this choice for our little girl. Because this mode of education is the most beautiful but also the most difficult to set up, because it has taught us a lot of things and it is sometimes difficult to get out of our minds from classic educational schemes j I decided to share my little daily victories in a blog.

feeds.title: From The Life of a Mother, But Not Only!
feeds.description: Céline, mother of Liloute (2011), Miniloute (2014) and Bébéloute (July 2020) A bit of everything, of us, of parenthood ... but not only!

feeds.title: Mes Doudoux et Compagnie
feeds.description: Me, it's Miss Brownie - a mother of 3 children in Lille. My blog is my way of freeing everything that comes to my mind and of sharing it. Then I think I need to write to feel good in my sneakers.

feeds.title: Confidences de maman
feeds.description: 1 mother with 2 children, 1 husband, 1 blog, and the creator and owner of a shop. Being a mom means so many things, we experience so many adventures so we might as well share them to play down or have fun!

feeds.title: Maman Floutch
feeds.description: Twins, close children, and family life in Clermont Ferrand. Blog posts cover articles on parenting, motherhood, lifestyle, and more.

feeds.title: C'est Maman qui l'a fait
feeds.description: Cooking recipe, cake design, decor ... find everything you need to treat, amuse and surprise in the kitchen!

feeds.title: Zozomum & cie
feeds.description: The leader of the gang is 30 years old, and it's me! I've always seen myself with a lot of kids, and obviously: it's a total success!I am a freelance in digital communication. I'm lucky enough to be able to reconcile professional and personal life.

feeds.title: Maman Plume
feeds.description: Welcome to my mom blog in Lille. Here I entrust you with my family life, my favorites, outings, readings, toys and tips.

feeds.title: Ritalechat
feeds.description: I am Camille. I opened 'La vie de Violette et Sacha' in 2011, when Violette was born. Like an album for my family who were far away, a way for them to see the children grow up. The blog changed its name. Ritalechat has remained a snapshot of our lives, of selected pieces, but it has also evolved. I like to leave my thoughts there, my questions as a woman and a mother.

feeds.title: Maman At Home
feeds.description: Mother of 2 boys-Nursery assistant for 7 years after 20 years in the comm. I like ice cream, read, run, have fun!

feeds.title: Ma Petite Organisation Blog
feeds.description: Behind Ma Petite Organization hides Sixtine, graphic designer since 2007 and mother of 4 children. She imagines and creates in 2012 Mon Petit Organiseur de Vie, an agenda that allows you to manage your personal, professional and family life in the same place.

feeds.title: e-Zabel
feeds.description: Isabelle, 2 children (16 and 14 years old), Parisian, influencer marketing consultant. Here is my daily life (since February 2008) with its joys, its struggles, humor and experience because ... NO, being a mother is not ONLY happiness! We talk about adolescence, travel, education and well-being ... all without too much waste.

feeds.title: Mom on the Balcony
feeds.description: Welcome to Maman au balcon, the family lifestyle blog open to the world. Logbook of a 30-year-old entrepreneur and mother of 2 birds, Seagull and Alouette.

feeds.title: Maman...What else ?
feeds.description: Aurélie, 32 years old. Full time mom of Mister E and Little B, my two little guys born in 2008 and 2010. Working mum with an eventful professional career and full of twists, I have always been Parisian and for 10 years, I share our life capsules on this blog.

feeds.title: Mamantestavis Blog de maman
feeds.description: I am Alexandra. I am 28 years old and I am the mother of my 4 year old Mini and my 8 month old Titou. Before my pregnancy, I went through periods of doubt, lack of confidence, questioning which remained unanswered.The arrival of my daughter was a click.From there, everything went very quickly, I wanted to share with other mothers this wonderful experience of being parents.

feeds.title: Mom's Pearls
feeds.description: Thirty-something from Lille, I am the mother of 2, a 7-year-old chouquette and a 3-year-old Tiboy. Here I share with you our favorites, our discoveries and also our little life! You can also find my reviews.

feeds.title: MamanDuVar
feeds.description: Mom's blog, not just for moms! Ideas for outings, culture, walks. Lifestyle. Recipes, travel & more.
